training_record.target: clean numerical prices divided by fixed quote SD; no observation-noise augmentation
training_record.conditioning: physical model parameters through logits; joint auxiliary curves excluded
training_record.scope: Validation selects the epoch and measures interpolation error against bank labels. Independent price/refinement and posterior checks remain required.

fit.selection: minimum validation mean squared error in quote-noise units

validation_errors.interpretation: Discrepancies against numerical labels mix emulator error and label randomness; they do not measure absolute price bias or grid error. Per-quote accuracy alone does not bound posterior distortion across all contracts.

validation_label_reported_mcse.interpretation: Reported label MCSE only; not independent price error or a grid-bias bound.

target: existing deterministic mean-emulator Gaussian quote likelihood plus exact prior-box logit Jacobian
limitations: Fixed-point checks are not posterior accuracy or prior-wide acceptance.
Rank7 eight-batch covariance is retained; it is not inverted or inserted into a likelihood.
MC label randomness, mean-emulator approximation and grid shifts remain separate errors.
Existing PyMC reference CLI uses DEMetropolisZ; this check does not change its sampler or add NUTS.
